taste.name: Evidence occupies the image slot
taste.trigger: When the first viewport needed a visual anchor
taste.decision: Chose a 401px by 387px operational workbench over a hero photograph or illustration
taste.reason: A visitor evaluating process automation can inspect a working mechanism sooner than they can trust a mood image

taste.name: Scroll pauses mark chapters
taste.trigger: When successive explanations could have been compressed into a shorter page
taste.decision: Chose 115px section intervals and 72px section padding over a dense continuous pitch
taste.reason: Each operational claim receives a reset before the next one, so the reader can retain the sequence rather than skim a wall of promises

taste.name: Orange behaves as a status signal
taste.trigger: When a second brand color could have spread across backgrounds and decoration
taste.decision: Chose tiny #D56D24 and #9C4E18 signal moments over broad orange surfaces
taste.reason: Rare color reads as a change in operational state instead of becoming atmosphere
evidence: Navy and paper remain the dominant fields

taste.name: Workshop edges replace soft containers
taste.trigger: When dense process material needed separation
taste.decision: Chose 2px to 4px corners and a 12px hard offset shadow over large-radius floating cards
taste.reason: The components feel handled and placed like tools or sheets, which keeps technical material grounded in work rather than presentation chrome
evidence: 12px 12px navy-tinted offset shadow on the workbench
